name: VITA Fertilidad Medicina Reproductiva Benidorm
title: VITA Medicina Reproductiva – Reproducción Asistida en Elche y Benidorm
paragraphs: WITH THE CONFIDENCE AND SECURITY OF A HOSPITAL ENVIRONMENT

At VITA, the first diagnostic consultation is completely free of charge and without obligation. In this first visit we will evaluate all aspects related to your fertility and that of your partner, studying the most appropriate treatment for your case.
In vitro fertilization (IVF) is the most widely used assisted reproduction technique, achieving pregnancy rates much higher than other techniques such as artificial insemination.
Anonymous egg donation is the most effective assisted reproduction technique, achieving the best pregnancy rates.
It successfully solves most male infertility problems.
